risks.title: Exit depends on completion and sale of unsold townhouses
risks.message: The only stated exit is settlement of 24 townhouse sales on completion. Repayment depends on construction finishing within the 30-month term and on buyers settling. On the application's own figures, about 65% of units are not yet sold. No fallback exit, such as refinance or other funds, is identified. The credit submission should explain how the unsold stock will be cleared and what happens if completion or settlements are delayed.

risks.title: No builder or building contract information
risks.message: This is an $11.7m construction loan, but the application does not name a builder. It also gives no fixed-price building contract, licences, insurance or track record. These are needed for the credit submission to address the builder requirements.

risks.title: Existing debt on the site not stated
risks.message: The application does not say whether any existing debt is secured on 45 Tambourine Road. Confirm with the broker whether there is current site finance to be refinanced or discharged.
